_: Written by `ci-video narrate`. Records which line each mp3 is a read of, in which voice, on which engine, at what prosody — so a later edit to any of those can be detected instead of silently keeping the old recording. Commit this with the mp3s.

open.text: Companion Capture lives in your menu bar and saves what you see and edit on this computer to your own Companion Memory.

first-run.text: The first-run assistant starts by saying what it records. Then it connects to your Core and asks for permission. Nothing is captured until you have signed in or added a key.

three-lanes.text: Screens takes a picture now and then and skips near-identical frames. Activity notes which app and window you are in. Files watches documents you edit, in folders you choose.

connect.text: In Settings you give it your Core's address, on your network or your Tailscale network, and sign in with your browser or an API key.

guard-rails.text: SSH keys, keychains, AWS credentials, GPG keys and password vaults are on a list you cannot switch off, checked before any file is fingerprinted. Crash reports hold panics only, and one setting turns them off.

platforms.text: There are installers for macOS, Windows and Linux. A few lanes are macOS first, and the README says which.

close.text: Let your computer remember for you, on a Memory you own. Visit ci dot computer. UnCloud your life.
